index.title: Auditing Financial Transactions
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Bookkeeping Auditor. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Auditing Financial Transactions. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a diff
index.what_happened_excerpt: This job is the public pattern for auditing financial transactions. It involves connecting a bookkeeping system, bank, and credit-card records to reconcile transactions, identify discrepancies, and review expenses for potential deductions.
